findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: Facility has one certified food manager certificate and she is not present at the time of the inspection as she announced that she will be stepping down from some of her duties. The person in charge at the time of the inspection is required to have a certified food manager certificate--facility plans to send two individuals to the class in the near future.
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use
findings.comment: Food handlers were observed drinking from coffee mugs in the kitchen. Storage of personal beverages and designated areas to eat and drink were discussed. Beverages were moved to the cart that is not in use for any other purpose in the side room.
findings.citation_text: 2-401.11  (C) Employee observed drinking in the food preparation area. Provide designated area for drinking.  Reference 2-401.11.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: Food handlers were observed entering kitchen for food prep without washing hands first and drinking from personal beverages without changing gloves or washing hands afterward. Hand washing was discussed with all food handlers present.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14  (P) Food employee must practice good hygiene by properly washing hands when changing tasks. Reference 2-301.14.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: 750.1210a 1)Seal countertop together next to popcorn machine. 2)Seal around the three compartment sink.
